payload.summary: Planned ri-09 (branch-local context checkpoints) at coordinated tier. Four parallel explore agents established that the isolation levers ri-09 needs already exist but are unconnected: the index namespace is hardcoded to main/main in semantic_adapter.py while the downstream CLI and promotion gate already support work_package namespaces, and the refresh path enforces no read scope while indexing_policy already enforces one. Selected Approach B at Gate 1: a composing module that reuses ri-06 types and the ri-05 producer registry but never writes the ri-06 operation store.

decisions.title: A checkpoint never writes the ri-06 operation ledger
decisions.rationale: ri-07 D9 makes a recorded producer result immutable for its revision and reused verbatim by later refreshes. A checkpoint result is scope-restricted and feature-namespaced, so admitting one into the canonical ledger would be unrecoverable within the existing contract rather than self-healing.

decisions.title: Index isolation is enforced by namespace, not by convention
decisions.rationale: Promotion into the canonical index is already gated on namespace_kind is MAIN and namespace_key == 'main'. Passing work_package makes the checkpoint structurally unable to reach the promotion path, so isolation rests on tested existing machinery instead of on checkpoint discipline.

decisions.title: Trigger derives from ri-08 context_impact, not a new size field
decisions.rationale: No required size field exists on work packages; loc_estimate, complexity and package_kind are optional hints that most packages omit. Deriving the trigger from declared context-impact surfaces ties it to the thing being reported on and needs no schema change.

decisions.title: Unmigrated packages are reported as unmigrated, not impact-free
decisions.rationale: The ri-08 detector returns None for a missing block and an empty frozenset for an explicit empty list. A missing block is absence of evidence; an empty list is an assertion. Collapsing them would let an unmigrated package appear verified.

decisions.title: Architecture coverage is a merge-base diff, not a slice
decisions.rationale: architecture-provenance.schema.json pins mode to the enum full|quick, so a slice mode would be a contract change. diff_architecture.py already exists standalone and is wired into nothing. Freshness and delta are reported separately because a stale artifact yields a misleading delta.

decisions.title: Checkpoints are report-only within ri-09
decisions.rationale: ri-10 owns turning deterministic drift into a CI or merge failure. Shipping a gate here would give ri-10 a gate to rework rather than a signal to consume.

next_steps: wp-contracts and wp-adapter have no dependencies and can dispatch in parallel first.
wp-checkpoint's ledger-isolation regression test (task 3.1) should be written before any checkpoint implementation, since it pins the decision the whole approach rests on.

relevant_files.description: approved proposal with Approach B selected at Gate 1
